subject: ACME Payments — implementation transfer: SDK setup, endpoint migration, and retry guidance
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@acmepayments.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Jul 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: ACME Payments — implementation transfer: SDK setup, endpoint migration, and retry guidance

Hi team,

Looping in Diego (implementation lead) and Ben (solutions eng) to take ownership of the technical onboarding for ACME Payments (deal RWF-3290). Samantha — thanks again for the productive pilot. ACME is ready to move from evaluation to an initial production integration and we need to coordinate SDK setup, endpoint migration from their test key to prod, and recommended retry/timeouts so their payment flows stay within SLAs.

Key context:
- Traffic profile: bursty peak of ~120 requests/minute during batch settlements, average 25 req/min otherwise.
- Initial integration uses our hosted API, plan to start with the smaller model variant for cost control and then scale.
- Procurement is finalizing contract; expected go-live window: 2027-07-20 to 2027-07-23.

Attachments: acme-integration-checklist.pdf (high-level milestones), sample-config.yaml (example runtime settings).

Immediate asks:
1) Diego: please propose a cutover runbook for endpoint migration and expected downtime window (if any).
2) Ben: please provide short SDK snippets (JS + Python) that show recommended timeout/retry logic and rate-limit handling that we can hand to ACME engineers.
3) Samantha: confirm SCIM/webhook recipients and whether you need private deployment (VPC) or hosted will suffice for the first phase.

I'll schedule a 30-min handoff call for Thu 07/08 — proposed times: 10:00am PT / 1:00pm ET. Let me know if you prefer a different slot.

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@acmepayments.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Jul 2027 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ACME Payments — implementation transfer: SDK setup, endpoint migration, and retry guidance

Thanks Monica — picked this up. A couple quick clarifying Qs before I draft the runbook:
- Which API keys will we rotate at cutover? Will ACME switch their client-side key only, or do they need us to swap server-side routing (we can keep a shadow route during the cutover).
- Expected token lengths and average response size? This helps size our connection pool and set per-request timeouts.

Ben — for the SDK snippets, will a small example showing exponential backoff + respect for X-RateLimit-* headers be enough? I can add a short test harness to simulate their settlement bursts.

Samantha — can you confirm if there will be a proxy in front of your integration (some customers have an API gateway that causes extra latency and we tune timeout slightly higher).

— Diego
Senior Implementation Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@acmepayments.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amit Rao <amit@finosolutions.io>
Date: Fri, 09 Jul 2027 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ACME Payments — implementation transfer: SDK setup, endpoint migration, and retry guidance

Thanks all — this is very helpful.

Samantha here — confirmed: hosted deployment is fine for phase 1. We'll aim for the cutover window 2027-07-21 02:00–04:00 UTC (local team approved). We'll also provide the new API key to the portal 24 hours before the window.

Next steps:
- Monica: please confirm the handoff call time (Thu 07/08) and share calendar invite.
- Ben/Diego: please share the final runbook and SDK snippets after you iterate; we'll run an internal smoke test on 07/18.
- Amit (cc'd) is our procurement lead and will coordinate the final signature once we have the runbook and the SLA addendum.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Samantha
VP, Engineering — ACME Payments
